d:
Receding, ash-grey hair styled in a neat, short cut. Stern, sunken pale-blue eyes. Appears to be in his late fifties with a weathered, mature face. Tall, stiff build with an unnatural, rigid posture. Wears a formal black frock coat with a high collar, a grey waistcoat, and a top hat. Features pale, stitched skin and a heavy metal bolt protruding from the neck.
BODY COLOR: greyish-pale
